integrity: The proof reconstructs all normalized Euclidean halfspace distances from the source definition. A first-row telescoping inequality gives the sharp upper bound, an explicit column profile attains it in every dimension, and equality forces the full first row of every incenter. A strict-slack witness proves the stated incenter-set dimension. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard-coordinate family PS_n^m(1,0) with n>=1 and m>=2. It does not give a formula for arbitrary top/bottom vectors or for the integrally equivalent grid-flow realization under its transported Euclidean metric. A residual originality risk remains for a general Chebyshev-center theorem for dominance-chain polytopes.
title: The generalized Pitman–Stanley staircase has dimension-free Euclidean inradius
